addr: UGF, No 1UG, 2UG, Bhartiya City Mall, Thanisandra Main Rd, Kannuru, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India

rev.t: We visited Bhartiya Mall of Bengaluru for dinner at Geist Brewing Co. and were pleasantly surprised to discover Fun Time - Kids Play Area. It turned out to be a fantastic addition to our evening. …

Okay place, many game places don't work at all. My son loves the sand(gravel) pit, so I bring him often. I like the staff they are very friendly and help the kids. The balls pit is no good most of the times the balls don't fly there because they turn off the wind pump.
Possibly the worst kids playground in all of Bangalore. Half the machines are either broken or defective, everything is overpriced, and the points on the card expire in only three months.
